string.name: library_subtitle
string.value: Your books, at your own pace.

string.name: empty_description
string.value: Import an EPUB from your device. Your library and reading position are saved offline.

string.name: kosync_description
string.value: Use the same server, account, and EPUB in Readest. KoSync shares reading positions; import books separately.

string.name: password_unchanged
string.value: Leave empty to keep saved password

string.name: newer_wins
string.value: The newer position wins. Missing or tied timestamps require a choice. Keep device clocks accurate.

string.name: about_description
string.value: HarmonyReadest 0.1 · Built for HarmonyOS with the Readest/Foliate reader engine. AGPL-3.0-or-later. Official Readest cloud sync is planned for a later release.

string.name: conflict_description
string.value: These positions differ and their times cannot be ordered. Automatic upload is paused until you choose.

string.name: remove_description
string.value: Remove this book and its local reading data?

string.name: error_https_required
string.value: Enter a valid HTTPS server URL.

string.name: error_not_kosync
string.value: This URL did not return a KoSync JSON response.

string.name: error_credentials_unavailable
string.value: Saved credentials could not be decrypted. Connect again.

string.name: error_duplicate_book
string.value: This EPUB is already in your library.

string.name: error_invalid_epub
string.value: This file is not a valid EPUB.

string.name: error_drm_or_encrypted
string.value: Encrypted or DRM-protected EPUBs are not supported.

string.name: error_fixed_layout_unsupported
string.value: Fixed-layout EPUBs are not supported in this release.

string.name: error_book_too_large
string.value: The book is empty or exceeds the supported size (128 MB compressed / 512 MB expanded).

string.name: error_unresolved_position
string.value: The server position could not be restored. Automatic upload is paused. Check that both apps use the same EPUB, or explicitly push your local position.

string.name: error_import_timeout
string.value: Import timed out. Try a smaller EPUB.

string.name: error_reader_timeout
string.value: The reader did not restore the position in time.

string.name: error_server_error
string.value: The sync server returned an error. Retry later.

string.name: error_invalid_progress
string.value: The server returned an invalid reading position.

string.name: error_generic
string.value: The operation failed. Your saved reading data is retained. Retry or check the connection.
